title: Review recoverable target account data and identity migration
description:
As the owner, I want a concrete migration plan before moving the application.

Feature: Review recoverable target account data and identity migration
  Scenario: Observable acceptance
    Given the read-only Legacy inventory and no approved dedicated account
    When a migration plan is reviewed
    Then target account backup/recovery identity continuity callbacks validation and rollback are explicitly approved while all existing data remains preserved

Planning only. No new implementation, deployment, paid call or permission is authorized by this record.

## Current next-step plan — 2026-10-17

Backups and reversibility precede migration. Prior inventory5b6177f reports21tables/~37,704items,32,069S3objects/~8GiB/~2users, no listed backups/PITR/versioning; no new live inspection is performed in this task. PR67 draft2546b7d proposes protections but remains unmerged/undeployed with a failing semantic-contract check.

Feature: Recoverable migration planning
  Scenario: Prove recovery before copying application data
    Given an approved exact source-protection and backup scope
    When the operator produces source backups and safely verifies restoration/export
    Then a recoverable baseline and evidence exist before any target migration
  Scenario: Preserve data and identity continuity
    Given approved target account and reversible migration plan
    When a candidate migration is evaluated
    Then records object references score behavior identity-linked ownership callbacks and denied access are preserved
    And rollback is concrete and no original source is removed

Await separate approval for source-protection deployment, backup/resource access, target bootstrap and actual migration; no full-admin proposal. Related marketing issueapricityweb-e02316.

Authority: Ryan requested this plan as the permanent Kanbus record. This action updates documentation only. The desired product outcomes are requested priorities, not claims of implementation or hosted acceptance. Existing implementation owners retain their approvals; recommendations needing further scope, release, permission or migration direction stay explicitly gated. No feature code, deployment, paid call, permission change or unrelated merge is performed here.

comments.text:
2026-10-19 handoff status (Claude project thread, taken over by another agent).
DECIDED by Ryan: full migration (not the light path); reuse an EXISTING org account, not a new one; target is apricity-production, account 873363353715, AWS CLI profile "Endymion" on Ryan's M1 Mac; no Legacy backup step needed (Ryan has a local copy). Plan doc: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/4dfe5cad-f156-4437-87a8-532e42cd510c
AWS ACCESS RULE: cloud sessions never get AWS credentials (key creation is blocked; CLI login is interactive with Ryan's thumbprint). Every AWS command must run on Ryan's M1 Mac in a Remote Control session (folder ~/Projects/Chattic.us). Cloud agents only write code, PRs and plans.
DONE: draft PR AnthusAI/Apricity#67 (play callback URLs, retain/deletion-protection/PITR/versioning in CDK) and draft PR AnthusAI/Apricity-web#1 (marketing CloudFormation pipeline, publishing off by default). Neither is merged. Nothing in any AWS account has been changed.
STALLED: a read-only check of apricity-production on Ryan's Mac was started 2026-10-17 16:33Z; no result was ever reported (the Remote Control session flapped offline/online repeatedly through 2026-10-17 18:58Z and then the session record was lost). Treat the account contents (CDK bootstrap, existing resources, Amplify, CodeConnections) as UNKNOWN until re-inspected.
OPEN PROBLEMS: (1) #67 had a failing Semantic ground contracts check and an unrelated Rust test failure; last known head 2546b7d, CI statuses currently report none. Re-run and fix. (2) Plan step 5 uses DynamoDB export-to-S3, which requires PITR on the source tables, but the plan dropped Legacy PITR/backups; resolve this contradiction (either enable PITR on Legacy with Ryan's approval, or use a scan/batch-writer copy). (3) #67 promoted to main deploys to Legacy; do not promote without Ryan's approval.
NEXT: re-run the read-only inspection of 873363353715 on the Mac; fix CI on #67 and merge to develop only; then ask Ryan for explicit word approval of each AWS step, one at a time (plan steps 3-9). No AWS action without his explicit approval.
